class.name: DiffUtil
class.brief_description: Static entry point that computes the diff between two lists.
class.description: DiffUtil is the port of [i]androidx.recyclerview.widget.DiffUtil[/i]. Call [method calculate_diff] with a [b]DiffUtilCallback[/b] subclass to compute the minimal update script between an old and a new list. The returned [b]DiffResult[/b] can be dispatched to a [b]ListUpdateCallback[/b]. Most users go through [method ListAdapter.submit_list] instead, which wires this up automatically.

method.name: calculate_diff
method.description: Static. Computes the diff between the old and new lists described by [code]callback[/code] and returns a [b]DiffResult[/b]. When [code]detect_moves[/code] is true (default) it also detects moves.
